stories.title: Riding to a game with Miami mom Linda Fletcher
stories.summary: Mark Fletcher Jr.'s mom has a fear of flying, but it hasn't stopped her from going to every one of her son's games.

stories.title: Doncic's 53-point explosion pushes scoring average past 40 as Lakers roll
stories.summary: Luka Doncic poured in a season-high 53 points in Friday's 124-118 win over the Blazers, raising his scoring average to 40.1.

stories.title: In Cleveland return, James finishes with just eight points in 76ers' loss
stories.summary: Returning to Cleveland as the opposition for the third time in a different NBA uniform, LeBron James struggled Friday night. finishing with eight points on 3-for-12 shooting with six turnovers in Philadelphia's 119-96 NBA Cup game loss to the Cavaliers.

stories.title: UConn stars find redemption, sweet revenge vs. Michigan in title game rematch
stories.summary: UConn's Silas DeMary Jr. and Braylon Mullins redeemed themselves after April's title game letdown, combining for 44 points to lead the Huskies past reigning champion Michigan.

stories.title: Warriors' Porzingis to 'step away' from NBA to prioritize his health
stories.summary: Kristaps Porzingis has announced that he will "step away" from the NBA to prioritize his health. He has not played for the Warriors this season.
